eligibility_text: Any Indian citizen with a viable business plan for a non-farm income-generating micro or small enterprise (manufacturing, trading, or services) — includes street vendors, artisans, and small shopkeepers.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 10 lakh across three tiers: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh), issued by banks, NBFCs and MFIs under a government credit guarantee.
source_note: Core three tiers stable since 2015 — check mudra.org.in for any newer higher tier before quoting a ceiling above Rs 10 lakh.
